info.title: Matomo Reporting API for Annotations plugin

get.description: Create a new annotation for a site.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The site ID to add the annotation to.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date the annotation is attached to.

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: The text of the annotation (max 255 chars).

parameters.name: starred
parameters.description: Whether the annotation should be starred.

200.description: Returns an array of two elements. The first element (indexed by 'annotation') is the new annotation. The second element (indexed by 'idNote' is the new note's ID).

get.description: Modifies an annotation for a site and returns the modified annotation and its ID.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The site ID to add the annotation to.

parameters.name: idNote
parameters.description: The ID of the note.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date the annotation is attached to. If null, the annotation's date is not modified.

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: The text of the annotation (max 255 chars). If null, the annotation's text is not modified.

parameters.name: starred
parameters.description: Whether the annotation should be starred. If null, the annotation is not starred/un-starred, so the current state won't change.

200.description: Returns an array of two elements. The first element (indexed by 'annotation') is the new annotation. The second element (indexed by 'idNote' is the new note's ID).

get.description: Removes an annotation from a site's list of annotations.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The site ID to add the annotation to.

parameters.name: idNote
parameters.description: The ID of the note to delete.

get.description: Removes all annotations for a single site. Only superusers can use this method.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The ID of the site to remove annotations for.

get.description: Returns a single annotation for one site.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The site ID the annotation is linked to.

parameters.name: idNote
parameters.description: The ID of the annotation to get.

200.description: The annotation. It will contain the following properties: - id: the ID of the annotation - idsite: the site the annotation is linked to - date: The date the annotation was recorded for. - note: The note text. - starred: Whether the note is starred or not. - user: The user that created the note. - canEditOrDelete: Whether the current user is permitted to edit or delete this annotation

get.description: Returns every annotation for a specific site within a specific date range.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The site ID to get annotations for. Can be one ID or a list of site IDs.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date of the period.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period type.

parameters.name: lastN
parameters.description: Whether to include the last N number of periods in the date range or not.

200.description: An array that indexes arrays of annotations by site ID. ie, array(   5 => array(     array(...), // annotation #1     array(...), // annotation #2   ),   8 => array(...) )

get.description: Returns the count of annotations for a list of periods, including the count of starred annotations.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The site ID(s) to get the annotation count for.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date of the period.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period type.

parameters.name: lastN
parameters.description: Whether to get counts for the last N number of periods or not.

200.description: An array mapping site IDs to arrays holding dates & the count of annotations made for those dates. eg, array(   5 => array(     array('2012-01-02', array('count' => 4, 'starred' => 2)),     array('2012-01-03', array('count' => 0, 'starred' => 0)),     array('2012-01-04', array('count' => 2, 'starred' => 0)),   ),   6 => array(     array('2012-01-02', array('count' => 1, 'starred' => 0)),     array('2012-01-03', array('count' => 4, 'starred' => 3)),     array('2012-01-04', array('count' => 2, 'starred' => 0)),   ),   ... )
